excerpt.zh:
星系地图可以提供对群星的大局观。可以用它来导航、扩张、指挥舰队以及标注边境。

打开星系地图；

£dot_green£在屏幕下方点击星系图标或按M键


                        £galaxy_view£
excerpt.en:
The Galaxy Map offers a strategic view of the stars. Use it to navigate, expand, command fleets, and monitor borders.

To open the Galaxy Map;

£dot_green£ Click the Galaxy icon at the bottom of the screen or press M


                        £galaxy_view£
